notes.title: Update no 1
notes.content:
[u][b]Update no 1.[/b][/u]


- merging/splitting task forces functionality updated

- resolution setup issue resolved

- "Skin" button prompts added

- game is not crashing when you click on the sea

- increased font size on the battle summary map

- french port name spelling correction (in already saved campaign the port name will stay unchanged)

- campaign name removed from the map (now visible for first 10 seconds)

- deleting"last waypoint" function updated - click the right mouse button on a selected waypoint

- fuel reserve adjusted, ships have enough fuel to play a battle

- formation name translation correction, kątowa (PL) to positional


additional, in DE version:

- german flag changed to black-white-red
